Automation

Keep every clock on time with Home Assistant

The free LYWSD02 Clock Sync integration sets your clocks automatically, follows daylight saving changes and lets you choose °C/°F, 12/24 h and a time correction. No YAML, no cloud.

  1. 1

    Add LYWSD02 Clock Sync to HACS.

    Open in HACS
  2. 2

    Download it, then restart Home Assistant.

  3. 3

    Accept the discovered clock, or add it yourself.

    Add a clock
  • Every night at 04:00 by default
  • Daily, weekly, monthly or cron
  • Daylight saving fixed within the hour
  • Works with ESPHome Bluetooth proxies

Requires HACS and Bluetooth in Home Assistant: a local adapter or a proxy with active connections. Read the guide
